constraints: keep primary evidence as the first visual
decision.expected_visual_effect: evidence leads clearly to a supported decision implication
decision.selection_reason: unique registered, human-admitted, materializable pattern matched the structured request

composition.title: Asymmetric evidence to decision
composition.summary: A dominant evidence field supports a smaller but visually decisive implication without reducing the page to equal cards.

mapping.reading_path: dominant evidence to supporting findings to decision implication

spatial_rules.spatial_behavior: allocate more area to evidence while keeping the implication visually final
preserve comparable evidence scales inside the dominant field

requires: one evidence object is the approved first visual
a decision implication is supported by that evidence
avoid_when: both sides are independent peer decisions

failure_guards.summary: Peer-looking containers give unequal semantic objects the same visual weight and erase the intended attention order.
verification: the first visual is recognizable within three seconds at thumbnail size
supporting objects remain subordinate in the rendered slide

failure_guards.summary: The rendered spatial relationship communicates a different meaning from the approved semantic relation.
verification: the rendered reading path matches the approved relation order
the composition plan and Layout Tree remain traceable
